name: Bodyweight Calf Raise
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with the balls of your feet on it and your heels hanging off, holding a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes.
Pause at the top, then lower your heels below the step for a full stretch.
Do the movement slowly for the best results.
image_prompt_scene: Standing on the edge of a step with the balls of the feet on it and the heels lowered.
